skill.name: self-test
skill.description: Guide AI coding agents to test, lint, and typecheck implementation work before reporting completion.
skill.summary: Use a repeatable self-test loop to verify code changes before completion.
skill.author: Clouder0

content.value_statement: Implementation work can finish with missed failures. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through tests, lint, and type checks before completion.
actual_capabilities: Defines an iterative loop for tests, lint, and type checks.
Lists common npm and pytest test command patterns.
Lists TypeScript, ESLint, mypy, and ruff command patterns.
Provides a checklist for work before completion.
Instructs agents to fix failures before continuing.
limitations: Does not detect the correct commands for each repository.
Does not replace project-specific CI configuration or review.
Example commands may need changes for nonstandard test setups.
Does not prove behavior that lacks useful test coverage.

use_cases.title: Verify a Feature Change
use_cases.description: Run focused checks after implementing a feature, then fix failures before reporting completion.

use_cases.title: Guide an AI Coding Session
use_cases.description: Keep Claude, Codex, or Claude Code aligned with tests, lint, and type checks during implementation.

use_cases.title: Standardize Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Give contributors a clear pre-completion checklist for tests, lint, type checks, and console errors.

prompt_templates.title: Run Basic Checks
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation after a small change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the self-test loop for my recent change. Run the relevant tests, lint, and type checks, then report any failures.

prompt_templates.title: Add Tests While Building
prompt_templates.prompt: As you implement this feature, add or update tests for each changed behavior. Run focused checks before moving to the next part.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the self-test pattern to verify this bug fix. Confirm the failing case now passes and check nearby affected behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Repository Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a self-test plan for this repository. Identify focused checks, broader checks, lint, type checks, and the final completion criteria.

output_examples.input: Check whether my new parser work is ready.
output: Lint passed after one formatting fix.
The change is ready for review.

output_examples.input: Use the self-test loop while adding form validation.
output: Added validation coverage for empty, invalid, and valid inputs.
One test failed during implementation and was fixed.
Final tests, lint, and type checks passed.

output_examples.input: Tell me if this task can be marked complete.
output_examples.output: Not complete yet. The focused tests passed, but lint still reports issues that must be fixed first.

best_practices: Run focused checks after each meaningful code change.
Use the repository's own documented commands when available.
Report failing checks honestly and fix them before completion.
anti_patterns: Declaring completion before tests, lint, and type checks run.
Running only broad checks when a focused failing case exists.
Ignoring warnings or console errors because tests passed.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gives the agent a workflow and example commands to use with available tools.

faq.question: Which languages does it support?
faq.answer: It includes examples for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python, but the workflow can fit other projects.

faq.question: Can it choose the right command for every repository?
faq.answer: No. It tells the agent to prefer project-specific test, lint, and typecheck commands.

faq.question: Is this useful with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should happen when a check fails?
faq.answer: The agent should fix the issue, rerun the check, and avoid marking the task complete.

faq.question: Does this replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It improves implementation verification but does not replace review or CI gates.
